name: Moong Dal Chilla
steps: Soak split mung beans, then blend with a little water into a smooth pourable batter.
Stir chopped onion, tomato, spinach, salt and cumin into the batter.
Heat a little oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour a ladle of batter and spread into a thin round.
Cook until the underside is golden, then flip and cook the other side through.
